items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); McVay: felt lack of power/explosion, will test pregame. Minor per Rapoport but game-time.
items.why: Calf injury left Thursday practice early; Friday DNP, pregame test.
items.implication: If OUT, heavy funnel to TEs/WRs; DFS slate pivot.
items.opportunity: routes/targets to Higbee primary, Parkinson, Atwell

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle); crucial for DFS slate. Practiced, 'heading in right direction' but GTD possible.
items.why: High ankle sprain, limited/full progression Friday, self-reported improving.
items.implication: Ravens offense ceiling if active vs CIN; monitor early news.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); returned limited practice after multi-game absence.
items.implication: If active vs MIA, immediate start; Berry agrees start if plays.
items.opportunity: lead back snaps/carries vs soft run D

items.text: OUT: Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet + more. Schefter full list corroborates.
49ers ruled OUT Mike Evans (Achilles/ribs) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) for Sunday vs Falcons; Rapoport coach confirm on Evans.
items.why: Official designation; Evans Achilles, Deebo hamstring.
items.implication: Massive WR vacuum funnels to Kittle + CMC involvement.

items.text: IN: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson + others. Jacobs was at facility for non-football activities.
items.implication: Jacobs start-worthy; Judkins active; Addison/Hock reliable.
items.opportunity: full snaps for Jacobs vs poor backups EPA

items.text: Tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot amid dire 49ers WR injuries + Kaelon Black presence; CMC smiled at question. Rarely buys RB-as-WR hype but this setup different.
items.why: WR outs (Evans/Deebo) + coach/player comments open slot role.

items.text: Saquon Barkley looks set to return Week 7 vs DAL; if active, goes right back into lineups (Stephania Bell agrees). Efficient in prior full games.
items.why: Return from hamstring, MNF vs Cowboys soft matchup.

items.text: Start Breece Hall if active vs MIA. Loves Jaylen Warren (Steelers special). Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec both games.
items.why: Hall matchup + usage; Warren film; Loveland spike post-Caleb return + Kmet IR.
items.opportunity: Hall snaps; Warren role; Loveland targets/routes

items.text: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: Adams already OUT + Puka Q creates TE/WR vacuum in 13-personnel heavy scheme.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring). 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB prod +4.4% (7th most); recent RB catches high. Sweet full-opportunity setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob official OUT; SF weak vs RBs recently (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.implication: Bijan full workload + receiving vs soft DvP.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Ignore 'National TE Day' narrative.
items.why: WR outs create target vacuum in Shanahan offense; Kittle elite.

items.text: Luther Burden: only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR (season-ending) should reduce 2/3-TE sets for more juice. TreVeyon Henderson just 21% snaps L3 weeks.
items.why: Burden efficiency + Kmet IR (Rapoport/Johnson confirm season-ending); Henderson snap share crash.
items.implication: Burden breakout candidate; fade/ downgrade Henderson.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @CHI, DeVonta Smith vs DAL, Tucker Kraft @DET, Matthew Golden @DET (deep targets vs Lions high deep-comp %).
items.why: Matchup/usage: Bears soft, Lions TE/WR vulnerable (9 TE TDs), Golden deep lead.
items.opportunity: targets, deep routes, red-zone for Kraft
